title: SEBI Secondary Market Framework and T+1 Settlement Cycle
source: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
content: Indian equity secondary markets operate on a T+1 (Trade date + 1 working day) rolling settlement cycle enforced by SEBI. When shares are sold on T-day, pay-out of funds and securities settlement completes on the next working day (T+1). All stock brokers must issue contract notes within 24 hours of trade execution detailing brokerage, STT (Securities Transaction Tax), GST, and exchange transaction charges.
